links.outcome: Nurses' general awareness and understanding of AI in nursing
links.effect: About one third reported no general awareness of AI; 45.8% (n=183) reported little to no understanding of AI use in nursing; 38.8% were reluctant to adopt AI personally.
links.quote: About one third of the participants reported having no general awareness of AI, and nearly half (45.8%, n = 183) reported little to no understanding of the use of AI in nursing.

unlisted_practices: Psychometric validation of a scale measuring nurses' knowledge of and attitudes toward AI

screen.reason: Empirical survey and psychometric validation of a scale assessing nurses' attitudes and knowledge toward AI in healthcare, reflecting human factors and readiness for AI adoption.
